newsitem.title: USA: Reliv says stock off on short selling.
newsitem.headline: Reliv says stock off on short selling.

text.p: Reliv International Inc said Tuesday its shares dropped 3-1/8 at 8-1/2 on short-selling after the stock hit a new 52-week high on October 28.
"I think we had a short-seller in there," Fred Nielson, spokesman, said.
Reliv shares on October 28 closed at 11-5/8, up 5/8, a new 52-week high.

Nielson said Reliv's stock had been trading higher over about the past 10 days in anticipation of an announcement from the company. On October 28, Reliv announced a new food product, Arthaffect, which contains an ingredient that has been clinically shown to combat degenerative joint conditions.
